item.title: Australia to host USS Colorado as first US nuclear submarine under Aukus pact
item.description: The Pentagon has assigned the USS Colorado as the first US nuclear-powered attack submarine to join a rotating force to be based in Western Australia. The 115-metre (380-foot) Virginia-class submarine, armed with land-attack missiles and sophisticated torpedoes, would sail to the new Australian base in late 2027, officials said on Tuesday. The deployment was a “significant milestone” in building up a joint US-Australia-UK deterrence in the Pacific under their Aukus defence pact, the allies said... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: California farmer triples walnut revenue by selling directly to 300 customers from a list of 10k
item.description: A walnut farmer in California revolutionized his sales with a targeted email marketing campaign. Reaching out to prior cherry customers, he uncovered 300 interested buyers for his walnuts. This approach resulted in his gross revenue tripling against wholesale prices, proving that even a small customer base can boost income stability. Consequently, many farmers are now embracing direct sales strategies to lessen financial uncertainties. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: En un día cualquiera en Florence, una localidad cercana a Phoenix, el personal de la oficina electoral está realizando un simulacro de mesa, un eufemismo para referirse a los preparativos ante el infierno electoral.
